description: Part B of conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit (the open substrate q→1⁺ continuation). The bare q-Pochhammer object diverges at q₀=1.11 (branch-cut iπ tower past k*=log_{q₀}(1/x)); the exact algebraic-pole subtraction (log(x qᵏ)+iπ, no free parameter) yields reg(x)→Li₂(x)−π²/3, reproducing Li₂(x)'s x-dependence to machine precision (substrate + q→1⁺ limit) with a universal x-independent offset π²/3 = Li₂(1) branch point + Euler tail (∫₀^∞log(1−e^{−s})ds=−π²/6). Reduces gap (2) from a functional obstruction to fixing one scalar (the T_w Frobenius normalization). Part A anchor (q→1⁻→Li₂) reproduced. Scope-(a) positive-partial; no fit; nothing wired.

data.open_residue: one universal constant π²/3 (T_w Frobenius normalization) + the x→1⁻ edge; block stays kind:conjecture
data.verdict: Part B ADVANCED (scope-(a) positive-partial). The substrate q→1⁺ continuation of the q-Pochhammer partial product, with the exact algebraic-pole subtraction (log(x qᵏ)+iπ for the negative factors — no free parameter), reproduces the FULL x-dependence of Li₂(x) to machine precision, at the substrate q₀=1.11 and in the q→1⁺ limit, offset by the UNIVERSAL x-independent constant π²/3 = 2·(π²/6) (the Li₂(1) branch point + the negative-factor Euler tail). The bare object diverges (Re & Im, the branch-cut iπ tower) — that is audit gap (2), concretely located at k*=log_{q₀}(1/x). So the 'exact cancellation among algebraic poles' the conjecture requires reduces to subtracting ONE universal scalar π²/3 (the T_w Frobenius-pairing normalization): the substantive x-dependence half of gap (2) is CONFIRMED exact, and the residual open content is a single constant, not a functional obstruction. No fit; nothing wired; the block stays kind:conjecture (the categorical fixing of π²/3, and the x→1⁻ edge, remain).
